articles.title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users
articles.snippet: HSBC and Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint received Hong Kong’s first stablecoin issuer licenses in April. Anchorpoint began rolling out HKDAP in August.

articles.title: Sweden’s central bank revives e-krona debate as stablecoins and digital euro loom
articles.snippet: The Riksbank sees an e-krona as critical to securing national payments and monetary control.

articles.title: HSBC launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin for retail payments
articles.snippet: HSBC is rolling out RedCoin wallets to PayMe users, with plans to support tokenized investment subscriptions and expand into institutional uses.

articles.title: Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
articles.snippet: BLOOM seeks to cut costs by helping financial institutions coordinate cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits.

articles.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
articles.snippet: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.
